bannerText: Muse X Poster: bài đã điền sẵn (đã bỏ tag Binance). Bấm Post trên X để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: Muse X Poster v1.6: PAUSE ANOTHER EXTENSION WHILE POSTING. The user runs another extension in the same Chrome and wants it out of the way while a post is being filled/posted. The popup has a 'Pause another extension while posting' dropdown (chrome.management.getAll, this extension excluded); the chosen extension id is saved as pauseExtensionId. The background disables it (chrome.management.setEnabled false, needs the 'management' permission) only after a job is validated and the processing lock is held, and re-enables it after every outcome (POSTED, FAILED, READY), plus on install/startup as a safety net. A failure to pause never blocks the post. v1.5's paste-based fill, focused-editor selection, replace-instead-of-append, and fail-on-mismatch checks are unchanged.
